metadata.status: no SAE training; public pretrained SAE loaded for local geometry diagnostics

conservative_conclusion: Vector-based local PCA is now available for the public GPT-2 L8 SAE. The hedge+parent decoder set has participation_ratio=2.226 and PC2/PC1=0.363; the parent cluster has participation_ratio=1.296. These values should be interpreted as local geometric diagnostics, not proof of H7. They can strengthen or weaken H7 only after comparison to matched controls and after checking whether the same structure persists under broader neighborhoods.
